title: hieracium cerinthoides subsp. fourcadei
intro: Hieracium cerinthoides subsp. fourcadei, commonly known as a species of hawkweed, is a plant in the dandelion-like genus Hieracium. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, including providing relief from inflammation and pain, and has potential health benefits such as antioxidant and antimicrobial activities. The therapeutic actions of Hieracium cerinthoides subsp. fourcadei include anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which may contribute to its use in treating wounds and skin conditions. However, due to limited research, the bioactive constituents of this plant are not well-defined, but it is likely to contain flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds that may contribute to its medicinal effects.
